dialogues.speaker: Ritou Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Ritou bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree operation is coming to an end, but those who conceal their Visions still remain.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Following the orders of the Tenryou Commissioner, and in compliance with the command of Madam Kujou Sara, pursuit operations will avoid using force or disrupting the public as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Please don't worry. The Tenryou Commission will not use its public duties as an excuse to intrude on your daily lives.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commissioner guarantees this in his own name, and that of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! I've arrived at Ritou! Stop harassing outlanders all the time!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "Don't you ever forget the beating that you gave me!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "You cannot escape our rematch, you hear me?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Ugh! Can you stop vandalizing these boards everywhere you go? You keep talking about the same thing every time, too!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: If you want your rematch so much, come at me, then! Forget appearances or whatever... once this war is over, I will grant you your wish!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: So just knock it off already! If I wasn't an officer of the Kujou Clan, I would have sued you for harassment already!

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: All outlanders seeking to enter Ritou while the Sakoku Decree is in effect must provide valid documentation or they will be prohibited from landing.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Prohibited items are not allowed in Ritou. Weapons, camping gear and foreign specialties must be registered for taxation.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Please take care of your documentation and personal identification. They will not be replaced if lost!

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Anyone who has been in contact with the Sangonomiya must be put under surveillance in Ritou for one year and will not be allowed to leave.

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Outlander merchants, if you are facing any issues or difficulties in Ritou,"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Come find Mr. Kurisu at the International Trade Association. We will do our best to help you!"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "If there is anything that you don't understand or that troubles you, come look for us."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "The International Trade Association's doors are always open to outlanders from any nation."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Chiba Hanako, Chiba Ryuuichi, former workers at the Jakotsu Mine, technically certified, healthy, hard-working."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a job to pay for daily family expenses. We hope to work in the same place together."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Salary and benefits negotiable!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Higi Kai, former technician at Tatarasuna, technically certified, experienced in management, healthy."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a job to feed my family. Salary and benefits negotiable."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Nonomura Yuuya, former worker at Tatarasuna, healthy, hard-working, suitable for high risk positions!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking to have a stable job until the war ends."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Salary and benefits negotiable. Would like to have regular rest time!"

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Many workers have come to Ritou to look for employment after Tatarasuna was shut down.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commissioner will help everyone find a job. Please do not post any advertisements, as they will affect the image of the city.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Note that all job hunting advertisements will soon be taken down throughout Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The shutdown problem was taken care of recently. Most workers have found re-employment at the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: To prevent crime, those who refuse to accept job placements will be transferred to a central temporary holding location and prohibited from going outside.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: There might be another round of merchant ships arriving in Ritou from Snezhnaya soon. Everyone at the harbor, please prepare for their arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As a gesture of support, merchants from Snezhnaya may enjoy partial tariff reduction or exemptions.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As for Snezhnayan merchants currently residing in Ritou, please renew your documentation at the Kanjou Commission headquarters at your first convenience,

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: So as to avoid any inconvenience in your residential, travel, or business affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Yoshino Koheiji, Yoshino Koheita

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, robbery, night-time assaults, conspiring against officials, distributing belongings to innocent villagers to incite rebellion.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Midorikawa Shirou

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, riotous assembly, piracy, robbing officials, ambushing samurai, holding family members as hostages in an attempt to rebel against the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: This person and his accomplices are wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We ask that those in need of help please visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: (Outlanders with valid documentation will also receive some form of subsidy.)

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'd like to thank Lady Yae Miko and the Yashiro Commissioner for their good intentions. The problem is that the documentation approval process takes way too long..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "By the time the documentation is approved, all of the food aid will have been given out... this is really inconvenient for us outlanders."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We are sorry to hear that. We will take your feedback into careful consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, we hope the outlander merchants will be generous enough to donate and help the authorities out.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: To this effect, the Kanjou Commission has decided to increase the retail space rental fee five-fold. Thank you for your understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hmph, we've helped the authorities out alright, but who will help us?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Although we truly hope the war will end soon..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "At the same time, the dock at Ritou has become a lot more active thanks to this war."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Although our workload has increased by a lot, so have our wages."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Seeing my wife working so hard at the dock, seeing my kids looking forward to another good meal..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I suppose I should support the continuation of this war after all."

dialogues.speaker: Ritou Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Ritou bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Former Kanjou Commissioner Hiiragi Shinsuke now awaits the Almighty Shogun's judgment regarding his crimes of high treason. Owing to his age and in acknowledgment of his past contributions, he is presently indefinitely detained without bail.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: However, should he commit any more acts of treason during this detention, he will be branded a public enemy of the Inazuman state and his judgment shall be enacted with extreme prejudice and without any mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: While the Kanjou Commission debates the matter of his successor, the Commission's duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The duties of Kanjou Commission staff will not be adjusted. We urge all staff to remain calm and follow any arrangements sent from your superiors.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: As we are presently in a state of ceasefire and peace, imports to Watatsumi Island will resume.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Once the matter of trade route security is agreed upon by both the Shogunate and Sangonomiya, the commercial port to Watatsumi Island will be opened shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With Lady Miko's permission, the Grand Shrine will soon host a large-scale event.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: This is a rare opportunity, so we encourage all shrine maidens, clergy, and commission staff to make preparations soon!

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Message
dialogues.text: Lady Miko, Lord Commissioner, we beseech you both to please exercise some control over Naganohara Fireworks!

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Message
dialogues.text: We of the Fire Brigade are always stretched to breaking point every time Yoimiya takes part in a festival...

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Message
dialogues.text: Please, we implore you, take pity on us!

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Reply
dialogues.text: We would like to express our deepest apologies as well. We will be sure to keep Yoimiya in check in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Yashiori Island's Jakotsu Mine has been closed temporarily, with representatives from the Shogunate and Sangonomiya discussing future development. It will be reopened soon after an agreement has been reached.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Former miners from Jakotsu may claim job loss compensation from the Yashiro Commission estates and may also take the occasion to indicate preferred avenues of future employment.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The special privileges granted to Snezhnayan merchants in trade and in port affairs have been revoked. Any accumulated arrears must be paid within 2 weeks, or Ritou will not extend further protection to your goods and cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: We ask all shipments of military equipment and material to leave the borders of Inazuma and Sangonomiya immediately. The Fatui and all related personnel are included in this order.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You should've done this a long time ago! We barely had any breathing room with all these Snezhnayan merchants eating up all the privileges and getting special treatment!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Especially those Fatui loansharks! Now they'll get what's coming to them, hah!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: Yours Respectfully, Inaba Shizuko.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Their Excellencies, the Almighty Ogosho and Watatsumi's Divine Priestess, both express their deep grief at the many tragedies that occurred at Tatarasuna and on Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: From this day forth, the Shogunate and Sangonomiya will begin reconstruction and redevelopment work in these lands in partnership with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Together, we will pacify this war-torn land, bring the guilty to justice, and restore Inazuma's prosperity.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: All the more must we follow the divine wisdom of Her Excellency the Shogun, acting as one to accomplish the great cause of Eternity.

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Outlander merchants, if you are facing any issues or difficulties in Ritou,"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Come find Mr. Kurisu at the International Trade Association. We will do our best to help you!"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "If there is anything that you don't understand or that troubles you, come look for us."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "The International Trade Association's doors are always open to outlanders from any nation."

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The Outlander Affairs Agency is presently doing away with past unfair taxes and duties to lessen the burden on merchants in Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: We will seek deeper cooperation with the International Trade Association going forward in order to better serve local and outlander merchants alike.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Additionally, emigres from other regions seeking work here can submit documentation indicating their employment preferences at the Kamisato Clan estates.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! Didn't we agree to have a sumo duel? Where've you run off to!?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Bet you lost a fight and can't show your face outside anymore, eh? Hope you're not crying in some corner with your bald wings wrapped around yourself or anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Come on, don't worry about it! You win some and you lose some, am I right?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Seriously though, I've got no time for your moping. We've got a duel to settle!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou has never been defeated in battle and remains triumphant today. Please do not slander her, you knave!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I haven't seen Ritou quite as busy as it has been recently with all these guests from Sangonomiya coming ashore."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Well, that said, it was their protests toward the Shogun that got those corrupt Commissions knocked down a peg or ten..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's thanks to them that we outlanders can now look forward to better days."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Farewell, Ritou."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Many matters await me in my homeland, so please forgive my abrupt and early departure."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I have heard that Yashiori Island has been handed over to the management of Sangonomiya and that the once-bustling mines will no longer open..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It pleases me little to see my hometown change hands... But at least now I have hope to return at all."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hope that the Shogunate will take this as a lesson. Such a great 'loss' must never happen again..."

dialogues.speaker: "Artificial Onikabuto" Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Artificial Onikabuto Tournament is taking in applicants now!"

dialogues.speaker: "Artificial Onikabuto" Announcement
dialogues.text: Tough youngsters, hale old folks, depressed uncles, and alcoholic aunties! Everyone is free to participate!

dialogues.speaker: "Artificial Onikabuto" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Experience endless proxy battles here! The upcoming match is:"

dialogues.speaker: "Artificial Onikabuto" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Village Shophouse Sharptongue versus Baron Vishap Tamagoyaki! Battling it out in a high-stakes, winner-take-all, no-holds-barred brawl!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The trends nowadays among youngsters are... getting harder and harder to wrap one's head around."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We can expect the various commercial routes between us and the other nations to open up one after the other. Better days are coming soon, indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Many thanks to our friends and competitors here in Ritou for helping us to make it this far."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You're too kind. I think everyone believes that we'll make it as long as there's business to be done."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Haha, that's right! But don't get too chummy or lose your edge now — don't forget that we're rivals out there in the mercantile world!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: The Yae Publishing House's reader's forum will proceed as planned. Our outlander readers from Ritou are also welcome to make the trip here to the Publishing House!

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: Lady Yae Miko welcomes the attendance of passionate readers everywhere!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Fresh Dandelion Wine from Mondstadt! Osmanthus Tea from Liyue! High-grade Cor Lapis!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Don't ask how it got here — but ask us anything about the quality!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Citizens, please take note! Do not in any wise be taken in by the lying words of smugglers!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "There's been a youngster in Tenryou Commission garb going about recently. Is this some result of the Almighty Shogun's latest decrees?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I mean, seeing Commission members go about official business in public is not uncommon, exactly, but this kid just looks way too young."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I mean, I swear this kid looks younger than Lord Commissioner Ayato. I just can't convince myself that this is official business, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: We sincerely apologize for any subsequent confusion or misunderstandings.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: The staff involved have been severely reprimanded, and the Shogunate pledges to enhance communication discipline and eliminate any such incidents in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Let it be known that the matrimonial ceremonies have been delayed, and that further details will become available at a later date.
